name: BURA
description: Bura is a Russian point-trick card game for 2 players that uses a 36-card deck (6 through Ace). Each player receives 3 cards and draws after each trick. The trump suit is set by the last card dealt to the non-dealer. A dramatic feature: once a player believes they have 31 or more points in hand while the stock is exhausted, they may declare 'Bura!' and those trick points are counted immediately. The target is 31 points.

content.text: Bura is a Russian point-trick card game for 2 players that uses a 36-card deck (6 through Ace). Each player receives 3 cards and draws after each trick. The trump suit is set by the last card dealt to the non-dealer. A dramatic feature: once a player believes they have 31 or more points in hand while the stock is exhausted, they may declare 'Bura!' and those trick points are counted immediately. The target is 31 points.

A traditional Russian 2-player card game of the point-trick family. Bura is closely related to other Eastern European draw-trump games. Documented in Russian card game literature through the 20th century.
Deal 3 cards each. Turn the last card face-up as trump indicator; place it under the stock pile with the suit visible.

items.text: 3-Player Bura: Some variants allow 3 players with a reduced deck or adjusted point target.
